correction.reason: The added capture-before-prototype fixture returned Object.prototype, which does not inherit public RegExp getters; it now returns RegExp.prototype. Both binaries were rerun with identical corrected source.

limits: The new complete direct RegExp directory includes pattern-language tests; it is not the complete RegExp tree.
All 8102 older case observations, 2216 controls, source fingerprints and policies are identical.
The new selection gains 16 passes and retains all 200 unsupported modes and eight resource stops.

Four modes exceed current nesting while compiling 200 nested groups; capture capacity also needs work. Two XML-pattern modes exceed regexp work, and two full-UTF16-space loop modes exceed script work.
Resource stops prevent a healthy baseline for this profile. No runner policy, quota or existing baseline is relaxed.
Unicode regexp syntax, flat bounded group parsing, broader legacy grammar, realms and remaining String/RegExp symbol protocols remain incomplete.
RegExpCreate has separate direct-conversion semantics; full String match/search protocol dispatch is not claimed.
Tests and local self-review do not establish complete allocation accounting or independently audited security.
